faqs.q: What is the Fluidyne WF104 Series Orbital Motors, 2-Bolt SAE A Mount and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The Fluidyne WF104 Series Orbital Motors, 2-Bolt SAE A Mount is a low-speed, high-torque orbital hydraulic motor, listed in 298 part numbers with displacement 80 to 475 cm³/rev. Orbital motors suit machine drives that need torque at low shaft speed, and displacement sets the trade between speed and torque. The mounting is 2-bolt SAE A.

faqs.q: How do I identify the part number of the Fluidyne WF104 Series Orbital Motors, 2-Bolt SAE A Mount?
faqs.a: Quote the part number from the motor nameplate, which carries the model code. For example WF104-1034 (1 1/4" 14T spline shaft, 2-bolt SAE A mount, 7/8-14 O-ring ports) and WF104-50022Y (475 cm³/rev, 7/8" 13T spline shaft, 2-bolt SAE A mount, 7/8-14 O-ring ports) are two of the 298 rows. The size table gives the displacement, shaft and port details for each part number.

faqs.q: What displacement range does the Fluidyne WF104 Series Orbital Motors, 2-Bolt SAE A Mount cover?
faqs.a: The Fluidyne WF104 Series Orbital Motors, 2-Bolt SAE A Mount spans 80 to 475 cm³/rev across 298 part numbers. That is 10 distinct displacements. A larger displacement turns slower with more torque for a given flow, and shaft speed in rpm is roughly flow in US gpm × 231 ÷ displacement in in³/rev, before volumetric losses.

faqs.q: Which shaft options does the Fluidyne WF104 Series Orbital Motors, 2-Bolt SAE A Mount offer?
faqs.a: The shaft options on the Fluidyne WF104 Series Orbital Motors, 2-Bolt SAE A Mount are 1 1/4" keyed, 1" keyed, 1 1/4" 14T spline, 1" SAE 6B spline and 4 more. Match the shaft to the machine, because keyed, spline and tapered shafts do not interchange. Give us the shaft type and diameter from your old motor, and the part number if you have it.

faqs.q: What pressure, speed and torque ratings does the Fluidyne WF104 Series Orbital Motors, 2-Bolt SAE A Mount have?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure or speed figures for the 298 part numbers of the Fluidyne WF104 Series Orbital Motors, 2-Bolt SAE A Mount. The ratings depend on the displacement and the build, so give us the working pressure, flow and torque you need and the part number, and we confirm the motor with the maker before supply.

faqs.q: What mounting and port options does the Fluidyne WF104 Series Orbital Motors, 2-Bolt SAE A Mount have?
